movie.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
movie.overview: Following the breakout success of the song 'I Can Only Imagine', MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream—sold-out arenas, a devoted fanbase, and a thriving career. But behind the spotlight, Bart's past threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son Sam. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life through their unlikely friendship. Bart soon discovers that Tim carries hardships—and secrets—of his own, forcing him to face his past and repair his relationships with Sam and his wife Shannon before fame costs him what matters most.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Following the success of 'I Can Only Imagine,' MercyMe lead singer Bart Millard must navigate the pressures of fame while confronting lingering past trauma to repair his fragile relationships with his family.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: MercyMe's Bart Millard enjoys massive success after the hit song 'I Can Only Imagine,' filling sold-out arenas across the country. However, the relentless demands of fame and unaddressed past trauma begin to fracture his home life, especially his relationship with his son Sam and wife Shannon. When hopeful musician Tim Timmons joins their major tour, an unlikely friendship forms between the two artists. Through Tim's hidden struggles and resilient perspective, Bart gains the clarity needed to face his past and fight for what truly matters.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Riding the unprecedented wave of success from their breakout anthem 'I Can Only Imagine,' MercyMe and lead singer Bart Millard reach the pinnacle of the Christian music industry. Despite achieving his professional dreams with sold-out tours and an eager fanbase, Bart secretly struggles under the weight of his old emotional wounds. The strain of constant touring begins to tear at the foundation of his family, deepening a growing rift with his son, Sam, and testing his marriage with Shannon. Seeking fresh inspiration, the band invites vibrant newcomer Tim Timmons to join their largest arena tour to date. Tim's contagious gratitude and unique outlook slowly begin to shift Bart's perspective on life and ministry. However, Bart soon realizes that Tim's joyful exterior conceals deep personal hardships and undisclosed burdens of his own. Witnessing Tim's silent faith in the face of adversity forces Bart to confront his own unresolved past rather than running from it. Ultimately, Bart must step away from the allure of the spotlight to do the difficult work of restoring his bond with Sam and recommitting to his family before fame costs him everything.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Following the massive success of MercyMe's iconic anthem 'I Can Only Imagine,' frontman Bart Millard finds himself living out his dreams on major arena stages. Yet behind the bright lights and praise, Bart faces a quiet crisis at home, where unhealed scars from his upbringing threaten to tear apart his marriage to Shannon and distance him from his fragile son, Sam. When rising artist Tim Timmons joins the band on their biggest tour yet, an unexpected camaraderie develops. Tim’s uplifting spirit brings much-needed perspective to Bart’s life, but as Tim’s own hidden trials come to light, Bart is challenged to face his deepest vulnerabilities and prioritize his loved ones above his career.

story_structure.climax: Tim's secret hardship comes to light, forcing Bart to confront his past head-on and take urgent responsibility for his family before his choices permanently sever his home life.
story_structure.conflict: As Bart navigates the pressures of fame, lingering unresolved issues from his past strain his relationship with his wife Shannon and threaten his bond with Sam.
story_structure.resolution: Bart embraces deeper gratitude and active reconciliation, prioritizing his family above career ambition to rebuild trust with Shannon and Sam.
story_structure.introduction: Following the success of 'I Can Only Imagine', Bart Millard enjoys a flourishing music career, but struggles to maintain a healthy connection with his family, particularly his son Sam.
story_structure.risingAction: Joining MercyMe on tour, newcomer Tim Timmons strikes up an impactful friendship with Bart, bringing newfound perspective while harboring his own hidden personal struggles.
